sort.title_vi: Khi tường thuật (said…), mỗi câu nói lùi sang thì nào?

groups.name: Past simple (liked, was…)
groups.rule_vi: Câu gốc ở hiện tại đơn ==like, is, don't have== → lùi thành **quá khứ đơn**: liked, was, didn't have. __is → was, don't → didn't.__

groups.name: Past continuous (was doing)
groups.rule_vi: Câu gốc có ==am/are + V-ing== (hiện tại tiếp diễn) → **quá khứ tiếp diễn: was/were + V-ing**. __Chỉ đổi am/are thành was/were.__

groups.name: Past perfect (had done)
groups.rule_vi: Câu gốc ==have lost, discovered, have finished== (hiện tại hoàn thành hoặc quá khứ đơn) → **quá khứ hoàn thành: had + V3**. __Quá khứ đơn cũng lùi thành had + V3.__

unjumble.sentence: She told me that she had finished her homework.
unjumble.hint_vi: tell + người nghe + that; lùi thì sang quá khứ hoàn thành
unjumble.why_vi: **told + người nghe (me) + that + mệnh đề**; ==had finished== là quá khứ hoàn thành sau khi lùi thì. __told luôn cần người nghe ngay sau.__

unjumble.sentence: The scientist said that the results were very surprising.
unjumble.why_vi: **said that + mệnh đề**: ==the results were very surprising== (are → were). __Không có người nghe nên dùng said.__

unjumble.sentence: Nam told us that he would come up with a plan.
unjumble.why_vi: **told us that + mệnh đề**; ==would come up with== (will → would). __Cụm come up with giữ nguyên thứ tự 3 từ.__

unjumble.sentence: My teacher said she was proud of our research.
unjumble.hint_vi: said (không có người nghe); có thể bỏ that
unjumble.why_vi: **said + mệnh đề** (bỏ that được): ==she was proud of our research==. __proud of sth: tự hào về điều gì.__

unjumble.sentence: They said they could not find any evidence.
unjumble.why_vi: **said + mệnh đề**: ==could not find any evidence== (can't → could not). __not đứng sau could, trước động từ.__

truefalse.s: Minh said me that he had a new laptop.
truefalse.fix: Minh told me that he had a new laptop.
truefalse.why_vi: Có người nghe ==me== thì không dùng said → **told me** (hoặc said to me). __say không đi thẳng với người nghe.__

truefalse.s: The teacher told us that the lab was closed.
truefalse.fix: The teacher told us that the lab was closed.
truefalse.why_vi: **tell + người nghe (us) + that** + mệnh đề đã lùi thì ==was closed== → câu đúng.

truefalse.s: Hoa said that she will visit the museum the following day.
truefalse.fix: Hoa said that she would visit the museum the following day.
truefalse.why_vi: Đã đổi ==the following day== nên động từ cũng phải lùi: will → **would**. __Lùi thì và đổi trạng từ thời gian phải đi cùng nhau.__

truefalse.s: Dr Phong said that he had discovered a new kind of plant.
truefalse.fix: Dr Phong said that he had discovered a new kind of plant.
truefalse.why_vi: ==had discovered== là **quá khứ hoàn thành**, lùi từ discovered hoặc have discovered → câu đúng. __said + quá khứ hoàn thành rất hay gặp.__

truefalse.s: My brother told that he was doing an experiment.
truefalse.fix: My brother said that he was doing an experiment.
truefalse.why_vi: ==told that== thiếu người nghe; không có người nghe thì dùng **said**. __tell luôn cần người nghe: told me, told us.__

truefalse.s: They said that they were working in the laboratory then.
truefalse.fix: They said that they were working in the laboratory then.
truefalse.why_vi: are working → **were working**; now → ==then== → câu đúng. __now trong câu tường thuật đổi thành then.__

truefalse.s: 'I love physics,' said Nam. → Nam said that I loved physics.
truefalse.fix: 'I love physics,' said Nam. → Nam said that he loved physics.
truefalse.why_vi: ==that I loved== sai đại từ: Nam nói 'I' thì tường thuật là **he**. __Đổi đại từ theo người nói.__

truefalse.s: 'I will call you tomorrow,' Linh told me. → Linh told me that she would call me the next day.
truefalse.fix: 'I will call you tomorrow,' Linh told me. → Linh told me that she would call me the next day.
truefalse.why_vi: will → **would**; I → she; you → me; ==tomorrow → the next day==. Đủ cả 4 thay đổi → câu đúng. __Đếm đủ 4 thay đổi trước khi chọn.__

exam.intro_vi: Phần Viết của đề chuyên Anh Sở Hà Nội có bài viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi, bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn. Chuyển sang câu tường thuật là dạng rất hay gặp.

exam.intro_vi: Đề chuyên có bài đọc hiểu chọn A, B, C, D: đề Chuyên Ngoại ngữ có 8 câu, đề Sở có phần Đọc 25 câu gồm nhiều bài. Hôm nay cậu làm bản rút gọn: 1 bài đọc, 5 câu.
exam.tip_vi: Mẹo: đọc câu hỏi trước, gạch từ khoá rồi tìm đoạn chứa thông tin. Đáp án đúng thường nói lại bằng từ khác, ít khi chép nguyên văn.
exam.passage:
Đức is thirteen and lives with his grandmother in a small town in Thanh Hoá. A few years ago, his grandmother's eyes became weak, and she often walked into tables and doors. One evening, after she fell and hurt her knee, Đức decided that he had to do something to help her.

He came up with the idea of a walking stick which could 'see' for her. With some help from his science teacher, he fixed a small sensor to the bottom of an old stick. When the stick came close to something, it made a loud beep. However, his first experiment did not go well. The stick beeped at everything, even at a sleeping cat or a leaf on the floor. Đức felt like giving up, but his teacher told him that every inventor made mistakes before a breakthrough.

For the next two months, Đức carried out more tests in the school laboratory and changed the sensor many times. Then his grandmother told him that the beeping embarrassed her when she went to the market. So Đức made the stick vibrate gently in her hand instead.

Last spring, his invention won second prize at a science fair for students in his province. Now his grandmother walks to the market on her own every morning. Đức says that his next goal is to make the stick cheap enough for every elderly person in his town.

items.q: Why did Đức decide to make the walking stick?
options: His teacher asked him to do a science project.
He wanted to win a prize at the science fair.
His grandmother often walked into things and got hurt.
His grandmother wanted to go to the market more often.
items.explain_vi: Đoạn 1: ==she often walked into tables and doors== và bị ngã đau đầu gối → **C**. __Giải thưởng (B) là chuyện xảy ra sau, không phải lý do.__

items.q: What was the problem with the first stick?
options: It was too heavy for his grandmother.
It beeped even at very small things.
It broke after the first test.
It was too expensive to make.
items.explain_vi: ==The stick beeped at everything, even at a sleeping cat or a leaf== → **B**: kêu cả với vật rất nhỏ. __A, C, D bài không nhắc.__

items.q: What did Đức's teacher tell him when the first experiment failed?
options: Every inventor makes mistakes before a big success.
He should stop working on the stick.
The sensor was too expensive to buy.
He needed a bigger laboratory.
items.explain_vi: ==his teacher told him that every inventor made mistakes before a breakthrough== → **A** (breakthrough ≈ big success). __Câu tường thuật trong bài thường chứa đáp án.__

items.q: Why did Đức make the stick vibrate instead of beeping?
options: The beep was too quiet to hear in the market.
The vibrating stick was cheaper to make.
His teacher said that vibration was safer.
His grandmother felt embarrassed by the noise.
items.explain_vi: ==the beeping embarrassed her when she went to the market== → **D**: bà ngại vì tiếng ồn. __A sai: bài không nói tiếng bíp quá nhỏ.__

items.q: What is the passage mainly about?
options: How to look after elderly people with weak eyes
A boy who invented something to help his grandmother
A science fair for students in Thanh Hoá
Why sensors are useful in modern life
items.explain_vi: Cả bài kể về Đức và chiếc gậy cậu làm cho ==his grandmother== → **B**. __Câu hỏi ý chính: chọn đáp án bao quát cả bài, không chọn chi tiết nhỏ.__

exam_easy.intro_vi: Đề chuyên có bài viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi, bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn. Hôm nay cậu chuyển lời nói trực tiếp sang câu tường thuật. Câu ngắn, mỗi câu chỉ cần đổi 2–3 chỗ.
exam_easy.tip_vi: Mẹo: 3 bước: (1) đổi I/my/we → he/she/his/her/they; (2) lùi thì: am → was, like → liked, can → could, will → would; (3) có người nghe thì dùng told.

items.q: 'I like my science teacher,' said Linh.
items.answer: that she liked her science teacher
accept: she liked her science teacher
items.explain_vi: ==like== → **liked**; I → she, my → her: **that she liked her science teacher**. __Có thể bỏ 'that'.__

items.q: 'I am drawing a rocket,' said Kiên.
items.answer: that he was drawing a rocket
accept: he was drawing a rocket
items.explain_vi: ==am drawing== → **was drawing**; I → he. __Hiện tại tiếp diễn lùi thành quá khứ tiếp diễn.__

items.q: 'We can see the moon,' the children said.
items.answer: that they could see the moon
accept: they could see the moon
items.explain_vi: ==can== → **could**; we → they. __Đổi đại từ theo người nói: các bạn nhỏ → they.__

items.q: 'My brother has a new robot,' Lan told me.
items.answer: that her brother had a new robot
accept: her brother had a new robot
items.explain_vi: ==has== → **had**; my → her (Lan là con gái). Có người nghe 'me' nên dùng **told**. __has/have lùi thành had.__

items.q: 'I will help you with your maths,' Dad said to me.
items.answer: that he would help me with my maths
accept: that he'd help me with my maths
he would help me with my maths
he'd help me with my maths
items.explain_vi: ==will== → **would**; I → he, you → me, your → my: **that he would help me with my maths**. __said to me có nghĩa như told me.__

exam_easy.intro_vi: Đề chuyên có bài đọc rồi chọn A, B, C hoặc D. Bài hôm nay ngắn, câu đơn giản, có 5 câu hỏi. Cậu không cần hiểu hết từng từ, chỉ cần tìm đúng câu chứa thông tin.
exam_easy.tip_vi: Mẹo: đọc câu hỏi trước, tìm từ khoá (Bin, every hour, at first…) trong bài, rồi đọc thật kỹ câu đó và câu ngay sau nó.
exam_easy.passage:
Mai is twelve years old, and she loves science. Her favourite room at school is the laboratory. Last month, her science teacher, Mr Nam, gave the class a project. 'Find a problem at home and try to solve it,' he said.

Mai thought about her little brother, Bin. Bin is five, and he never drinks enough water. He often has headaches in the afternoon. So Mai came up with an idea: a 'talking bottle'. She put a small speaker on an old water bottle. Every hour, the bottle says, 'Hello, Bin! It's time to drink some water!'

At first, Bin was scared of the bottle, and he hid it under his bed. But after two days, he started to love it. Now he drinks six glasses of water every day, and his headaches have stopped. Mai's mother told her that Bin was much healthier now.

Mai showed her bottle to the class. Her friends laughed and clapped. Mr Nam said that it was a simple but clever invention. Next year, Mai wants to make a talking bottle for her grandfather too, because he often forgets to drink water.

items.q: What was Bin's problem?
options: He didn't like his sister.
He was often late for school.
He didn't drink enough water.
He was afraid of the dark.
items.explain_vi: ==he never drinks enough water== → **C**; vì thế Bin hay đau đầu. __Tìm tên Bin trong bài rồi đọc các câu ngay sau.__

items.q: What does the bottle do every hour?
options: It tells Bin to drink water.
It plays music for Bin.
It cleans the water.
It calls Mai's mother.
items.explain_vi: Mỗi giờ chai nói =="It's time to drink some water!"== → **A**: nhắc Bin uống nước. __Từ khoá 'every hour' giúp cậu tìm đúng câu.__

items.q: How did Bin feel about the bottle at first?
options: happy
scared
hungry
bored
items.explain_vi: ==At first, Bin was scared of the bottle== → **scared**. __Câu hỏi có 'at first' thì tìm 'at first' trong bài.__

items.q: What did Mr Nam say about the bottle?
options: It was too expensive.
It was very noisy.
It needed a bigger speaker.
It was simple but clever.
items.explain_vi: ==Mr Nam said that it was a simple but clever invention== → **D**. __Câu tường thuật 'said that' thường chứa đáp án.__

items.q: What is the best title for the passage?
options: A Day at the Zoo
Mai's Talking Bottle
Bin's New Bed
How to Cook Rice
items.explain_vi: Cả bài kể về ==a 'talking bottle'== Mai làm cho em trai → **Mai's Talking Bottle**. __Tên bài phải nói được ý chính của cả bài.__

exam_plus.intro_vi: Bài đọc ở đề Chuyên Ngoại ngữ có những câu phân loại: hỏi nghĩa của từ trong ngữ cảnh, ý chính của một đoạn, điều tác giả ngụ ý. Bài hôm nay khoảng 250 từ, từ vựng mức B2.
exam_plus.tip_vi: Mẹo: phương án sai thường lấy từ trong bài nhưng nói quá lên (most, always, rarely) hoặc ngược ý. Đối chiếu từng chữ với câu gốc trong bài.
exam_plus.passage:
Many people imagine that great inventions are always the result of careful planning. In reality, some of the most useful breakthroughs happened almost by accident.

In 1945, an American engineer named Percy Spencer was carrying out tests on radar equipment when he noticed that the chocolate bar in his pocket had melted. Instead of simply complaining about his ruined snack, Spencer became curious. He placed some popcorn kernels near the machine and watched them pop all over the laboratory. This observation eventually led to the microwave oven. The first models, however, were nearly two metres tall and far too expensive for ordinary families, so it was many years before microwaves became a common sight in kitchens.

A similar story took place in 1968, when a chemist called Spencer Silver was trying to develop an extremely strong glue. What he produced instead was so weak that paper stuck with it could be removed easily without leaving a mark. For years, nobody could think of a use for it. Then a colleague, Art Fry, came up with the idea of using it to make bookmarks that would not fall out of his songbook. The result was the sticky note, which can now be found in offices all over the world.

These stories suggest that luck alone is not enough. Both men turned their accidents into inventions because they paid attention to unexpected results rather than dismissing them as failures.

items.q: What does the writer suggest in the first paragraph?
options: Most great inventions are the result of luck.
Not every important invention is carefully planned.
Careful planning is a waste of time for inventors.
Accidental discoveries are rarely useful.
items.explain_vi: ==some of the most useful breakthroughs happened almost by accident== → **B**: không phải phát minh nào cũng được lên kế hoạch. __A nói quá (most) – cẩn thận từ chỉ mức độ.__

items.q: According to the passage, why did it take a long time for microwave ovens to become common in homes?
options: People believed they were dangerous.
They could only be used to make popcorn.
The early models were too large and costly.
Spencer refused to sell his invention.
items.explain_vi: ==nearly two metres tall and far too expensive for ordinary families== → **C** (large and costly). __A, D bài không nhắc.__

items.q: What was surprising about the glue that Spencer Silver produced?
options: It was much stronger than he had planned.
It left marks on everything it touched.
It held paper only lightly and could be removed cleanly.
It was invented by his colleague, Art Fry.
items.explain_vi: ==so weak that paper stuck with it could be removed easily without leaving a mark== → **C**. __A, B ngược ý bài; D sai vì Art Fry chỉ nghĩ ra cách dùng.__

items.q: The word 'dismissing' in the last paragraph is closest in meaning to
options: refusing to take them seriously
explaining them in detail
reporting them to others
repeating them carefully
items.explain_vi: **dismiss sth as…**: gạt bỏ, coi là không đáng quan tâm → **A**. Nó đối lập với ==paid attention to== đứng trước 'rather than'. __Dùng từ đối lập trong câu để đoán nghĩa từ mới.__

items.q: What is the main point of the last paragraph?
options: Luck is the most important quality an inventor can have.
Both inventors became rich because of their mistakes.
Scientists should try hard to avoid failures.
Inventors succeed when they pay attention to unexpected results.
items.explain_vi: ==luck alone is not enough… they paid attention to unexpected results== → **D**. __A trái ý bài, B không nhắc, C ngược thông điệp.__

paper_plus.instruction_vi: Dành cho mức Nâng cao. Câu 1–2: viết dạng đúng của từ in hoa (có thể phải thêm cả tiền tố lẫn hậu tố). Câu 3–4: viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi, bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn. Câu 5–6: chọn A, B, C hoặc D.

items.q: The first results turned out to be ______, so the team had to repeat the whole experiment. (RELY)
items.answer: unreliable
items.explain_vi: Sau ==turned out to be== cần **tính từ**; phải làm lại thí nghiệm nên kết quả không đáng tin → **unreliable**. __Thêm cả tiền tố un- và hậu tố -able.__

items.q: So far, the new theory has not been tested ______; it exists only on paper. (EXPERIMENT)
items.answer: experimentally
items.explain_vi: Bổ nghĩa cho ==has not been tested== cần **trạng từ**: experiment → experimental → **experimentally**. __Tính từ đuôi -al thêm -ly thành trạng từ.__

items.q: 'We haven't found any evidence yet,' the detectives told the journalist. → The detectives told the journalist ______
items.answer: that they hadn't found any evidence yet
accept: that they had not found any evidence yet
they hadn't found any evidence yet
they had not found any evidence yet
items.explain_vi: ==haven't found== → **hadn't found**; we → they: **that they hadn't found any evidence yet**. __Có người nghe nên giữ told; yet giữ nguyên.__

items.q: This is the cleverest solution that anyone has ever come up with. → Nobody has ever ______
items.answer: come up with a cleverer solution than this
accept: come up with a cleverer solution than this one
come up with such a clever solution
come up with such a clever solution before
items.explain_vi: So sánh nhất ==the cleverest ... ever== → **come up with a cleverer solution than this**. __Nobody + so sánh hơn mang nghĩa giống so sánh nhất.__

items.q: After months of failure, the team finally ______ a breakthrough in their search for a cure.
options: did
made
took
got
items.answer: B
items.explain_vi: Cụm cố định **make a breakthrough**: tạo bước đột phá → **B. made**. Có ==After months of failure== cho thấy cuối cùng đã thành công. __Học các cụm với make: make progress, make a discovery.__

items.q: The idea seemed crazy at first, but in the end it ______ to be a brilliant invention.
options: turned out
carried out
found out
came out
items.answer: A
items.explain_vi: **turn out to be**: hoá ra là → **A**. Có ==seemed crazy at first, but in the end== cho thấy kết quả trái với ban đầu. __carry out là tiến hành, find out là phát hiện, come out là ra mắt.__

writing_starters: I think the most important invention is …
It helps people … / Before it was invented, people …
My … (mum / grandfather / teacher) told me that …

part1.intro_vi: Mai và Tom nói chuyện về hội chợ khoa học của trường. Nghe và chọn đáp án đúng cho 5 câu hỏi.

script.t: Hi Tom. Are you ready for the school science fair on Friday?
Almost. My group is doing an experiment with plants and light.
That sounds interesting. What did you find out?
Well, we put one plant near the window and one plant in a dark cupboard. After two weeks, the plant in the cupboard was yellow and very small.
So plants need light to grow well. That's good evidence!
Yes. Our teacher, Mr Brown, said he was very pleased with our work. What about your group?
We're making a small car that runs on solar power.
Cool! Does it work?
Actually, it only works on sunny days. So we're testing it in the playground at lunchtime tomorrow.
Great. Can I come and watch?

items.q: What is Tom's experiment about?
options: Plants and water
Plants and light
Cars and the sun
Animals and food
items.explain_vi: Tom nói =="My group is doing an experiment with plants and light."== → **Plants and light**. __Xe chạy bằng mặt trời là của nhóm Mai.__

items.q: What happened to the plant in the cupboard?
options: It grew taller than the other plant.
It got lots of new leaves.
It died after two days.
It became yellow and very small.
items.explain_vi: =="the plant in the cupboard was yellow and very small"== → **It became yellow and very small.** __Bài nói 'two weeks', không phải 'two days' – bẫy C.__

items.q: What did Mr Brown say?
options: He was happy with the group's work.
The group should do the experiment again.
The plants needed more water.
The group was late with the project.
items.explain_vi: Tường thuật: =="Mr Brown said he was very pleased with our work"== → **He was happy with the group's work.** __pleased gần nghĩa với happy.__

items.q: What is Mai's group making?
options: A robot that can water plants
A pot for growing plants
A car that uses energy from the sun
A kite that flies in the wind
items.explain_vi: Mai: =="a small car that runs on solar power"== → **A car that uses energy from the sun.** __solar power nghĩa là năng lượng mặt trời.__

items.q: Where will Mai's group test their invention tomorrow?
options: In the science lab
In the school hall
At Tom's house
In the playground
items.explain_vi: =="we're testing it in the playground at lunchtime tomorrow"== → **In the playground**. __Nghe kỹ từ chỉ nơi chốn sau 'testing it in'.__

part2.intro_vi: Cô Lan giới thiệu câu lạc bộ khoa học mới của trường. Nghe và điền vào ghi chú, mỗi chỗ 1 từ hoặc 1 con số.
part2.script: Good morning, everyone. This is Miss Lan from the science department. I'd like to tell you about our new Science Club. The club meets every Wednesday afternoon in the school laboratory. In the first month, we'll carry out simple experiments with water and air. After that, you'll come up with your own ideas for small inventions. The club is free, but please bring a notebook to every meeting. There are only 24 places, so don't wait too long. If you'd like to join, please write your name on the list outside the library before Friday. Thank you!
part2.text:
SCIENCE CLUB
• Day: every [1] afternoon
• Place: the school [2]
• First month: experiments with water and [3]
• Bring to every meeting: a [4]
• Number of places: [5]

items.answer: Wednesday
items.explain_vi: =="The club meets every Wednesday afternoon"== → **Wednesday**. __Viết hoa chữ cái đầu của thứ trong tuần.__

items.answer: laboratory
accept: the laboratory
lab
items.explain_vi: =="in the school laboratory"== → **laboratory** (lab cũng được). __'library' xuất hiện sau là nơi ghi tên – bẫy.__

items.answer: air
items.explain_vi: =="simple experiments with water and air"== → **air**. __Ghi chú có sẵn 'water and', cậu chỉ cần nghe từ đi sau.__

items.answer: notebook
accept: a notebook
items.explain_vi: =="please bring a notebook to every meeting"== → **notebook**. __Ghi chú có sẵn 'a' nên chỉ viết notebook.__

accept: twenty-four
twenty four
items.explain_vi: =="There are only 24 places"== → **24**. __Viết bằng chữ số cho nhanh, đỡ sai chính tả.__

part1.intro_vi: Nam kể cho Anna về chuyến thăm một phòng thí nghiệm ở trường đại học. Nghe và chọn đáp án đúng. Chú ý chỗ người nói sửa lại thông tin.

script.t: Hey Nam, how was the trip to the university yesterday?
Brilliant, actually. We visited a laboratory where scientists do research on clean water. They're trying to make a cheap filter for families in the countryside.
Oh, that's useful. Did they let you try anything?
Yes! A scientist called Doctor Ha showed us a simple experiment. We poured muddy water through paper. Oh no, sorry, that's wrong. It was through sand and small stones.
And did the water come out clean?
Much cleaner, but Doctor Ha told us it still wasn't safe to drink. She said we would need to boil it first.
Interesting. Did she say anything about her research?
She said her team had worked on the filter for three years. And she told us they had finally made a real breakthrough a few months ago.
Wow. Would you like to work in a lab like that one day?
Maybe. I used to want to be a doctor, but now I'm thinking about chemistry.
Well, then you'd better start revising for our chemistry test on Monday. Oh, wait, it's on Tuesday, not Monday.
Oh no, I'd completely forgotten about it! Thanks for reminding me.

items.q: What are the scientists in the laboratory working on?
options: New kinds of medicine
A way to make water safer
Better ways to grow rice
The weather in the countryside
items.explain_vi: Nam: họ =="do research on clean water"== và làm 'a cheap filter' → **A way to make water safer.** __Đáp án đúng diễn đạt lại ý 'clean water'.__

items.q: What did the students pour the muddy water through?
options: Paper and sand
Paper only
Cloth and small stones
Sand and stones
items.explain_vi: Nam nói 'through paper' rồi sửa: =="It was through sand and small stones."== → **Sand and stones**. __Cẩn thận chỗ 'sorry, that's wrong' – người nói sửa thông tin.__

items.q: What did Doctor Ha say about the water after the experiment?
options: It had to be boiled before anyone drank it.
It was clean enough to drink straight away.
It was dirtier than before.
It should be tested in another lab.
items.explain_vi: =="She said we would need to boil it first."== → **It had to be boiled before anyone drank it.** __'still wasn't safe to drink' giúp loại phương án B.__

items.q: How long has Doctor Ha's team worked on the filter?
options: A few months
One year
Three years
Ten years
items.explain_vi: =="her team had worked on the filter for three years"== → **Three years**. __'a few months ago' là lúc có đột phá – bẫy A.__

items.q: When is the chemistry test?
options: On Monday
On Tuesday
Tomorrow
Next Friday
items.explain_vi: Anna sửa lại: =="it's on Tuesday, not Monday"== → **On Tuesday**. __Thông tin nói sau 'wait' mới là đáp án.__

part2.intro_vi: Cậu nghe lời thuyết minh ở một bảo tàng khoa học về chiếc lò vi sóng đầu tiên. Điền vào ghi chú, mỗi chỗ 1–2 từ hoặc 1 con số.
part2.script: Hello, and welcome to the Hall of Inventions. Some of the greatest breakthroughs in science happened by accident, and the object in front of you is a good example. In 1945, an American engineer called Percy Spencer was carrying out research on radar machines. One day, he noticed that the chocolate bar in his pocket had melted. He was curious, so he did a simple experiment. Some stories say he tested an egg first, but in fact, the first food he tried was popcorn, and it popped all over his laboratory! The egg came later, and it exploded. Two years after that, the first microwave oven went on sale. It wasn't small like the ones in our kitchens today. It was almost two metres tall and weighed about 340 kilograms. It was also very expensive, so at first it was mainly bought by restaurants. Now, please walk through to the next room.
part2.text:
THE FIRST MICROWAVE OVEN
• Percy Spencer's job: [1]
• What melted in his pocket: a [2]
• First food he tested: [3]
• Weight of the first oven: about [4] kilograms
• At first, mainly bought by: [5]

items.answer: engineer
accept: an engineer
items.explain_vi: =="an American engineer called Percy Spencer"== → **engineer**. __Nghe danh từ chỉ nghề đứng trước tên người.__

items.answer: chocolate bar
accept: chocolate
items.explain_vi: =="the chocolate bar in his pocket had melted"== → **chocolate bar**. __Ghi chú có 'a' nên viết đủ cụm chocolate bar.__

items.answer: popcorn
items.explain_vi: Nhiều người nghĩ là trứng, =="but in fact, the first food he tried was popcorn"== → **popcorn**. __'but in fact' báo hiệu đáp án thật.__

accept: three hundred and forty
items.explain_vi: =="weighed about 340 kilograms"== → **340**. __'two metres' là chiều cao – bẫy.__

items.answer: restaurants
accept: restaurant
items.explain_vi: =="at first it was mainly bought by restaurants"== → **restaurants**. __'at first' và 'mainly' trong ghi chú khớp với bài nghe.__

part1.intro_vi: Linh và Ben chọn đề tài cho cuộc thi khoa học. Nghe và chọn đáp án đúng. Có câu hỏi về ý kiến, thái độ và suy luận.

script.t: Ben, we really need to decide on our project for the science competition. The plan has to be in by next Monday.
I know. I was thinking we could test which drinks damage teeth the most. You know, putting eggshells in cola, orange juice and milk.
It's a fun experiment, but honestly, almost every school does that one. The judges must be tired of it by now.
Fair point. So what did you have in mind?
Well, I read an article about plastic in rivers. What if we collected water from the lake near school and analysed how much tiny plastic is in it?
That's much more original. But we'd need a proper microscope, wouldn't we?
Actually, I asked Mr Brown yesterday. He said we could use the one in the school laboratory, as long as he was there with us.
That's good news. But collecting samples every day would take ages, and I've got football training three evenings a week.
We wouldn't need to go every day. Mr Brown told me two samples a week would be enough, as long as we collected them at the same time of day.
Hmm, OK. I'm still a bit worried, though. What if we don't find any plastic at all?
Then that's still evidence! Mr Brown said a result we didn't expect could be just as interesting as one we did.
True. Right, I'm convinced, let's forget the teeth idea. Should we ask Mai to join us? She's brilliant at drawing graphs.
Good idea, but she told me she'd already joined another team. Maybe we could ask Nam instead.
Sure, I'll text him tonight.

items.q: Why does Linh reject Ben's first idea?
options: It would cost too much money.
It is too common to impress the judges.
It could be dangerous for their teeth.
It would take too long to finish.
items.explain_vi: Linh: =="almost every school does that one. The judges must be tired of it"== → **It is too common to impress the judges.** __Linh khen 'fun' nhưng chê vì quá phổ biến.__

items.q: What did Mr Brown say about the microscope?
options: They could take it home for a week.
They would have to buy their own.
They could use it only if he was present.
It was too old to be useful.
items.explain_vi: Tường thuật: =="we could use the one in the school laboratory, as long as he was there with us"== → **only if he was present**. __as long as nghĩa là miễn là.__

items.q: Why is Ben unsure about collecting samples at first?
options: He thinks the lake is too far from school.
He doesn't like going near water.
He thinks Linh won't help him.
He already has regular sports commitments.
items.explain_vi: Ben: =="I've got football training three evenings a week"== → **He already has regular sports commitments.** __Đáp án diễn đạt lại bằng từ khái quát hơn.__

items.q: What is Mr Brown's opinion about unexpected results?
options: They can be as valuable as expected ones.
They show the experiment has gone wrong.
They should be left out of the report.
They only happen to beginners.
items.explain_vi: =="a result we didn't expect could be just as interesting as one we did"== → **They can be as valuable as expected ones.** __just as … as nghĩa là cũng … như.__

items.q: What can we understand about Mai?
options: She is going to draw the graphs for them.
She doesn't get on well with Ben.
She is already working with another group.
She will contact Nam tonight.
items.explain_vi: Linh: =="she told me she'd already joined another team"== → **She is already working with another group.** __Người nhắn tin cho Nam là Ben, không phải Mai – bẫy D.__

part2.intro_vi: Nghe chương trình phát thanh về một nhà phát minh 15 tuổi. Điền ghi chú, mỗi chỗ 1–2 từ hoặc 1 con số. Cẩn thận thông tin gây nhiễu.
part2.script: Welcome back to Young Minds, the programme about teenagers who think like scientists. Today we're talking about fifteen-year-old Linh from Da Nang, who has come up with a clever way to keep vegetables fresh for longer. Linh's grandmother sells vegetables at a local market, and Linh noticed that she was throwing away a lot of spinach every week. At first, Linh guessed it was about a quarter, but when she weighed it, it was almost a third. Her first idea was to use plastic bags, but she soon realised they would only add to the waste problem. Instead, she carried out a series of experiments with natural materials. She tested banana leaves, rice straw and coconut fibre, and coconut fibre kept the vegetables fresh for the longest. Spinach wrapped in it stayed fresh for 5 days, compared with just 2 days without it. Her teacher told us that the most impressive thing was not the result itself, but how carefully Linh had recorded her evidence, including the tests that failed. Linh's next step is to find out whether the wrappers can be washed and used again.
part2.text:
YOUNG INVENTOR: LINH, AGE 15
• Grandmother threw away almost a [1] of her spinach
• Best material: [2]
• Spinach stayed fresh for [3] days
• Teacher praised how carefully Linh recorded her [4]
• Next step: test whether the wrappers can be washed and [5]

items.answer: third
accept: a third
items.explain_vi: Linh đoán 'a quarter' nhưng khi cân thì =="it was almost a third"== → **third**. __Nghe tiếp sau 'but' để lấy con số đúng.__

items.answer: coconut fibre
accept: coconut fiber
items.explain_vi: Thử lá chuối, rơm, xơ dừa; =="coconut fibre kept the vegetables fresh for the longest"== → **coconut fibre**. __Plastic bags bị loại từ đầu – bẫy.__

accept: five
items.explain_vi: =="stayed fresh for 5 days, compared with just 2 days without it"== → **5**. __Số 2 là khi không bọc – bẫy.__

items.answer: evidence
items.explain_vi: =="how carefully Linh had recorded her evidence"== → **evidence**. __Ghi chú dùng lại 'recorded her', cậu nghe từ ngay sau.__

items.answer: used again
accept: reused
re-used
items.explain_vi: =="whether the wrappers can be washed and used again"== → **used again** (reused cũng được). __Chỗ trống 1–2 từ nên viết 'used again'.__
